rulings.Case Title: KATHLEEN NILMEYER VS. BNSF RAILWAY COMPANY ET AL
rulings.Calendar Matter: Defendant Bnsf Railway Company'S Notice Of Motion And Motion To Transfer Venue To San Bernardino; Memorandum Ofpoints And Authorities
rulings.Rulings: On Asbestos Law and Motion / Discovery Calendar for Tuesday, September 8, 2026, Department 502, Line 2. Defendant BNSF Railway Company's ("BNSF") Motion to Transfer Venue to San Bernadino is CONTINUED to October 6, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. in Department 502. The continuance is based upon Plaintiff's Counsel's representation that he is in the process of identifying individuals who may have worked with Mr. Hodges in San Francisco. Plaintiff is to file and serve all supplemental declarations and evidence no later than September 21, 2026. BNSF may file and serve a supplemental response addressing any such evidence no later than September 28, 2026. = (502/EPS)
